<big>Ars Nouveau is an early game magic mod relying on the use of Glyphs to create spells.</big>
There is an in-game wiki labeled ‘Worn Notebook’ which is made with a book and lapis
The online wiki can be found here. The online wiki also lets you add certain ‘add-on’ mods that have provided their own content.
I would recommend viewing that wiki until this one is more fleshed out. Which may take a while.
There are three tiers of spellbooks, the Novice Spellbook, Mage Spellbook, and the Archmage Spellbook.
The Novice Spellbook just needs a book as well as an iron axe, sword, shovel, and pickaxe; Whereas the future spellbooks require both the previous tier and some other, more expensive materials.
